newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada gas aggregator prices seen surging in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Canada gas aggregator prices seen surging in Q1.

text.p: More evidence of a bullish Canadian gas market was revealed on Friday when an analyst predicted natural gas aggregator prices for the first quarter of 1997 could exceed the average set in the same period last year by 34 percent.

"For the balance of Q1 1997 weather and temperatures will play a key role but it seems highly likely that the Q1 1996 average of C$1.79 per (thousand cubic feet) will be exceeded, potentially coming through in the C$2.40 per MCF range," Martin Molyneaux, analyst with FirstEnergy Energy Capital Corp, wrote in a report.
"Clearly we're starting off 1996 with a major bang."

Molyneaux said the weighted average December 1996 price for Canadian aggregators TransCanada PipeLines Ltd unit TransCanada Gas Services, NOVA Corp unit PanAlberta Gas and ProGas Ltd was C$2.80 per MCF.
The price was C$1.22 per MCF, or 77 percent, higher than the average for December 1995.
He said the full-year weighted average price last year was C$1.75 per MCF, a 34-percent jump over the 1995 average of C$1.30 per MCF.
